cells.gaps: Three of 22 councils run Moptax (Freetown, Kenema and Makeni), a minority; Bo and Koidu are a procurement (May 2026). The rows disagree on where the record is held: the May 2026 notice says the system is integrated with the central monitoring system, the 2025 progress report says that integration was still expected in 2026; the newer stands.
cells.note: LoGRI reports Kenema's property roll on Moptax doubled to 27,545 with 45% compliance (SLE-025, September 2026), and Moptax running in Freetown, Kenema and Makeni (SLE-026): a register past its pilot outside the capital, stage 3. Three of 22 councils is a minority, so not 4.
